caption:
Every line on your resume can carry an evidence state.

In JobRez, evidence notes are entirely self-reported. You can attach a linked source with a URL attached, mark a claim as self-attested when a source was named, or leave it open when nothing supports the claim yet. Nothing on the platform is externally verified.

Learn more at jobrez.com.
